article_title: King Charles warns malicious online actors are evolving their tactics

tasks.prompt: What is the central message of the article?
options: The NCSC will be replaced by a private cyber-security company.
Asos has closed its shopping app permanently after a breach.
King Charles warned that hostile online actors are using evolving technologies, while praising the NCSC's work protecting the UK.
The King asked technology companies to stop developing all AI systems.
tasks.correct_answer: King Charles warned that hostile online actors are using evolving technologies, while praising the NCSC's work protecting the UK.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משלבת את אזהרת המלך מפני תוקפים מקוונים המשתמשים בטכנולוגיות מתפתחות עם שבח לפעילות ה־NCSC בעשור האחרון.

tasks.prompt: Why did King Charles write to the National Cyber Security Centre?
options: To mark the centre's 10th anniversary
To announce a new online retailer
To investigate the Asos breach personally
To appoint a new head of GCHQ
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכתב פורסם לציון עשור להקמת המרכז הלאומי לאבטחת סייבר.

tasks.prompt: In the King's letter, what does “resilient” most nearly mean when describing the online environment?
options: Completely free of technology
Controlled only by government agencies
Designed mainly for shopping
Able to withstand and recover from threats
tasks.correct_answer: Able to withstand and recover from threats
tasks.explanation_hebrew: resilient מתאר מערכת שמסוגלת לעמוד בפני איומים ולהתאושש מהם.

tasks.prompt: Which achievement did the King attribute to the NCSC?
options: Creating the Asos shopping application
Safeguarding democratic institutions and critical infrastructure
Regulating every frontier AI model worldwide
Publishing customers' personal details after cyber attacks
tasks.correct_answer: Safeguarding democratic institutions and critical infrastructure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המלך מנה בין הישגי המרכז הגנה מפני מתקפות, שמירה על מוסדות דמוקרטיים והגנה על תשתיות קריטיות.

tasks.prompt: Why did the King say much of the NCSC's work cannot be praised publicly?
options: Cyber-security operations often involve sensitive or secret information.
The centre has not recorded its achievements.
The NCSC works only outside the United Kingdom.
Public praise would automatically close online services.
tasks.correct_answer: Cyber-security operations often involve sensitive or secret information.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זו מסקנה סבירה מדבריו: פעילות הגנתית נגד איומי סייבר כרוכה לעיתים בפרטים רגישים שלא ניתן לפרסם.

tasks.prompt: What does “unauthorised activity” mean in Asos's description of the incident?
options: An approved update to its app
A public advertising campaign
Access or actions that were not permitted
A planned change to customer accounts
tasks.correct_answer: Access or actions that were not permitted
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unauthorised פירושו שלא קיבל אישור; כאן מדובר בפעילות אסורה הקשורה לפלטפורמות צד שלישי.

tasks.prompt: What happened in the Asos cyber incident described in the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהאקרים השתמשו במערכת האפליקציה לשליחת הודעה, שהאירוע נגע אולי למיליוני אנשים ושנחשפו פרטים אישיים נרחבים יותר משנמסר תחילה.
expected_points: Cyber criminals used Asos's own app system to send a pop-up notification.
The notification may have reached millions of people.
Hackers claimed to hold detailed user profiles, including contact details and dates of birth.
Asos investigated unauthorised activity involving third-party platforms.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the article connects the King's letter, the NCSC's role and recent cyber threats.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין אזהרת המלך, תפקידי ה־NCSC, דוגמת הפריצה ל־Asos והצורך בחוסן דיגיטלי.
expected_points: The King warned that malicious actors are evolving their tactics with automated technologies.
He praised the NCSC for a decade of defending the UK, its institutions and infrastructure.
The recent Asos incident illustrates the scale and personal impact of current cyber threats.
The letter argues that strong cyber security is necessary for a safer, more resilient digital environment.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article include both cyber-security threats and the King's separate warning about frontier AI?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר ששני הנושאים מדגימים כיצד טכנולוגיות חזקות ומתפתחות יכולות להועיל אך גם לשמש גורמים עוינים, ולכן נדרשים הגנה ופיקוח.
expected_points: Both sections concern rapidly evolving technology.
Automated tools and advanced AI can create opportunities as well as serious risks.
The King warned about misuse by malicious actors or technology falling into the wrong hands.
Together, the examples reinforce the need for security, regulation and human responsibility.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief neutral paragraph explaining the King's view of responsible technological development.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את הצורך בקידמה עם הגנת האנושות, הקהילה והטבע, וכן התמודדות עם סיכוני סייבר ו־AI בלי ניסוח דרמטי או מידע חיצוני.
expected_points: Acknowledge that new technologies can provide benefits.
Explain that strong cyber security is fundamental to managing risks.
Mention the danger of malicious use of automated systems or advanced AI.
State the King's view that technology should remain in the service of humanity, community and the natural world.
